I don't have any great ideas. The model is simple enough, and sample sizes appear adequate for each group. The scaling correction factor for your MLM solution seems quite high at 6.273, but maybe other people have experience with correction factors in this range.
     The "smallest eigenvalue" is not much smaller than 0 (-1 * 10 ^ -19.). There are no obvious out-of-bounds parameter estimates.
     My two suggestions would be:
     (1) try MLR instead of MLM--see if you get the same warning message with the somewhat different robust estimator;
     (2) since the combined sample does not throw the warning, impose equality constraints on subsets of your parameter estimates until the warning goes away, and thus maybe localize the issue.
